hook: Meet Qasar & Peter, leading the revolution in Physical AI.
body: Qasar Younis and Peter Ludwig at Applied Intuition have just published an article in Latent Space newsletter detailing their groundbreaking work in Physical AI. Their innovations are poised to transform industries by merging physical machines with artificial intelligence for unprecedented efficiency. This is not just a tech advancement; it's the future of how we interact with technology.
